question: Where can I find attraction that lies within 130 kilometers en route to Anything for Princess!, Sewaren, NJ from Art Clinic, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%attraction%' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anything for Princess!%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sewaren%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 130000 ) );
